demo.title: Demo
demo.text: Sample data in a throwaway profile: play freely, a reload starts it over. Your own data is not touched.

header.moreLabel: More: reset day, full screen, close app

main.ready: {strong} · Tap an activity to start tracking · hold one to set an earlier start
main.tapHint: Tap to switch · tap the running one to stop · hold for sessions
main.allGroupsOff: Nothing to show: all groups are off (Settings → Groups).
main.noActivities: No activities. Add some in Settings.

welcome.label: Welcome
welcome.title: New here?
welcome.text: Tap an activity to start the day · hold one to set an earlier start.

footer.tagline: A chess clock for your work day.

about.label: About
about.offline: This page is on the website, which this offline file does not include.
about.privacyNote: Privacy first: everything you track stays in this browser. No account and no internet connection needed. You are responsible for your data, so export a backup regularly.
about.statsUnavailable: This copy (the demo, the offline file or a local build) sends no usage stats.
about.statsHint: Which screens and features get used, never what you track. No cookies, no account, nothing personal.
about.statsDnt: Your browser asks sites not to track, so this is off until you turn it on.
about.statsPlea: It is your choice, and you can turn it off. Please consider leaving it on: Tap Time Tracker is free, and these counts are the only way to know anyone uses it. If nobody does, it gets no more updates and will be retired.

popularity.label: Size buttons by today’s usage
popularity.hint: Tiles grow wider, rows taller, circles larger as you use them

unusedStrip.label: Move unused activities to a strip
unusedStrip.hint: Activities with no time today become small chips under the buttons

showTimeline.label: Show today’s timeline
showTimeline.hint: The colored session bar at the bottom of the main screen

showGroups.label: Show group totals
showGroups.hint: Time per group and idle time, on one line under the timeline

showFooter.label: Show the footer
showFooter.hint: Links and the quick settings at the bottom of every page

session.deleteBody: {name} · {range} ({duration}). This time becomes idle. You can add it back in the day editor.

editor.title: Day editor
editor.clearBody: All its sessions are deleted. You can then rebuild the day with “Add range”.

feedback.title: Send feedback
feedback.offline: This offline file cannot send messages. Open the online version of the app to send feedback.
feedback.sent: Your message is on its way. Every one of them is read.
feedback.intro: A bug, a missing feature, or just that you use it: all of it helps decide what comes next.
feedback.emailHint: Email, only if you want a reply
feedback.device: Include the app version and browser
feedback.failed: It could not be sent just now. Your text is still here, try again in a moment.

profiles.runningNote: {strong} It keeps counting while another profile is open.
profiles.manage: Add, rename or delete profiles in Settings

profiles.intro: Each profile is a separate workspace with its own activities, groups, days, summary, settings and backup. One is open at a time; a running activity keeps counting while you are in another profile. A new profile starts with a copy of this profile’s settings.
profiles.name: Profile name
profiles.deleteBody: ALL its activities, days and history are deleted. This cannot be undone (export a backup first).

groups.intro: The main screen shows activities of groups that are on, plus those without a group. Several groups can be on at once; a group stays on or off until you change it.
groups.placeholder: Add groups: one per line or comma-separated
groups.name: Group name
groups.deleteBody: Its activities are kept and move to “no group”.

categories.intro: Categories split your time in the Summary. A dimension has options; each activity picks at most one option per dimension. Activities without one count as “Not set”, so every dimension adds up to 100%.
categories.deleteBody: Every activity loses its option of it. Nothing else changes.

activities.taken: Already exists (names are unique; a removed one can be restored or deleted below): {names}
activities.placeholder: Add activities: one per line or comma-separated
activities.removedIntro: Removed activities keep their history; restore them any time. Delete takes one off this list, and its tracked time stays in the summary. Adding an activity with the same name later continues that history.
activities.deleteBody: It leaves this list for good. Its tracked time stays in the summary.
activities.colorLabel: Color of {name}: change in Activity colors
activities.name: Name
activities.removeBody: Its history is kept and it can be restored.

theme.lowContrast: “{name}” is installed, but these activity colors are hard to see on its background (under 3:1): {slots}.
theme.intro: A theme sets the whole look: surfaces, text and the activity colors. The same idea as an editor or terminal theme.
theme.systemNote: Follow system: {light} in light mode, {dark} in dark mode. Tap a theme while the system is in that mode to change it (now: {mode}).
theme.name: Theme name
theme.deleteBody: Profiles that use it switch to Paper or Graphite.

colors.title: Activity colors
colors.intro: Each theme has 16 color slots, like a terminal palette. An activity picks a slot, so it changes color with the theme and stays readable in every one. With more activities than slots, colors repeat; names are always shown next to colors.

day.weekHint: used by the Week period, the calendar and the heatmap
day.minSwitchHint: shorter runs go to the next (or previous) activity
day.autoExport: Download a JSON backup when a day closes
day.autoExportHint: One file per closed day, in your downloads

device.languageHint: also used by the website on this device
device.fullscreenHint: On the first tap; the full screen icon toggles, hold Esc to leave
device.awakeHint: While the app is open and visible
device.awakeUnavailable: Not available here: needs localhost or HTTPS

backup.importBody: Import replaces ALL data and settings of the profile “{name}”. Other profiles are not changed.
backup.intro: Export and import cover this profile only; import replaces its data and settings.

summary.title: Summary
summary.emptyHint: Pick another period, or start an activity on the main screen.
summary.pickLastHint: Now tap the last day. Both days are included.
summary.pickFirstHint: Tap the first day, then the last day. Both days are included.
summary.shadedHint: Shaded days have tracked time. Weeks start on {day} (Settings → Day).
summary.avgHint: dashed: average start {start} · end {end} · tap a day for details
summary.tapOption: tap an option to see its activities
summary.name: Name
summary.noDataWeek: no data in the previous week

noDataDays.one: no data in the previous day
noDataDays.other: no data in the previous {n} days

dialogs.resetBody: {date} closes with {total} tracked and a new day starts. You can still edit the closed day from Summary.
dialogs.closeRunning: {name} keeps counting while the app is closed. Open the app again to stop it or switch.
dialogs.closeYourselfBody: The browser does not let this page close its own window. Press Alt+F4 or Ctrl+W.

errors.notExport: Not a Tap Time Tracker export
errors.itermXml: Unknown XML file (expected an iTerm .itermcolors file)
errors.jsonTheme: Unknown JSON theme (expected our theme file, a VS Code color theme or base16)
errors.themeFile: Unknown theme file (supported: our theme .json, VS Code .json, base16 .yaml/.json, Alacritty .toml, iTerm .itermcolors)
